status: optional research transport encoding; not production or privacy acceptance

frame.body: One zlib-wrapped DEFLATE stream; sender level 6. Empty body uses zero raw length and zero encoded length.
frame.decoder: Bound output at advertised raw length + 1; require exact length, EOF, no unused_data, no unconsumed_tail. No unbounded flush. Reject truncation, trailing data and concatenated streams.
frame.wire_canonicality: No unique compressed byte encoding required: signatures and hashes bind decoded raw bytes, never compressed bytes. Alternative valid streams for the same raw bytes are semantically equivalent.
frame.deadline: Existing absolute RPC deadline; check before and after codec work. No preemption or hard CPU deadline guaranteed.

unchanged_bindings: request metadata body_size and body_hash refer to original bytes
signed reply body_size and body_hash refer to original bytes
image_hash domain separation and canonical image format
witness namespace, authorization, expected sequence, digest, request token and CAS idempotency
raw image stored at witness and used for restore
application-level public schedule, logical slot count and transaction count

evidence.codec: Maximum body, empty body, incompressible expansion, limits before read, malformed streams, dishonest lengths, bomb, mode mismatch and deadline regression tests
evidence.rpc: Existing authenticated RPC and ambiguous-outcome recovery tests repeated through compressed mode, using the same TLSWitnessClient class
evidence.experiment: 6 count/histogram schedules, poll cadence 0/1/8; each CAS image encoded and round-tripped locally; paired identical final snapshots over actual loopback mTLS, 8 CAS and 8 image GET samples per mode
evidence.restoration: Exact canonical image equality, local audit and R1-R8 final projections match independent generated public transcript; receiver fixtures retained
evidence.byte_accounting: Stream totals are measured codec output, not whole-query network traffic. Snapshot counts are actual application frame bytes passed to successful sendall, exclude TLS/TCP/IP/handshake.
evidence.sample_percentile: Nearest rank; with 8 observations p95 is the maximum, not a stable tail estimate.
